content: I'm Nicole Deschamps (HUESOFSATURN). I build creative coding tools — primarily BlobFX, a browser-based real-time video effects app with 63 stackable effects, GPU shaders, AI masking, audio reactivity, and a timeline editor. I work in vanilla JS with p5.js, no frameworks. I use Claude Code (Opus 4.6) as my primary dev tool with multi-agent workflows.

BlobFX architecture: 9 modular JS files loaded via script tags in shared global scope. Load order matters: core → fx → shader-fx → overlay → audio → timeline → mask → tracking. 20,330 lines total. WebGL2 shader pipeline (ShaderFXPipeline class) handles 33 GPU effects with per-effect opacity and blend modes. 400+ implicit globals — no namespace yet, known tech debt.

Decision: Use return false (not return;) in p5.js mousePressed(). p5.js only suppresses browser default behavior when the handler returns false. Using bare return caused OS file dialogs to cascade — 14+ stacked dialogs when clicking FX tabs because label-for elements propagated clicks to hidden file inputs. Discovered via Playwright testing 2026-03-25.

Decision: iOS Safari file inputs must use <label for> pattern, never programmatic .click(). iOS blocks programmatic file input clicks. Also: file.type can be empty on iOS — always fall back to extension check. Two rounds of fixes still haven't fully resolved iOS upload. Playwright misses iOS-specific issues — must test on real device.

Decision: paramValues priority system — USER > TIMELINE > AUDIO. Audio and timeline both want to drive effect parameters. Priority system with paramBaseline + paramOwner prevents them from fighting. User input always wins. Per-effect audio sync uses stable _baseValue captured from FX_DEFAULTS on first frame, not live value — reading live value caused feedback loop saturating to max instantly.

BlobFX is my strongest portfolio piece for job applications. 63 effects, GPU shader pipeline, AI masking, audio reactivity — this is a stronger signal to creative tech / frontend / VFX employers than any tailored resume. Public launch serves double duty: creative tool release + living portfolio. When applying via job-ops, include a live BlobFX demo link.

JobHunt (Flask app at ~/Desktop/Documents/Resume) and job-ops (Docker pipeline at ~/job-ops) are COMPLEMENTARY tools, not competing. JobHunt handles Playwright autofill + hand-tuned 5-category match scoring (skills 40%, title 20%, experience 20%, location 10%, industry 10%). job-ops handles broader job sources (LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor/Adzuna) + AI resume tailoring via RxResume. Both stay.

12 critical QA bugs in BlobFX found 2026-03-26, unfixed: maskSegInFlight never reset on mode exit (blob-mask.js), InteractiveSegmenter no GPU→CPU fallback on Safari, audioContext.resume() not awaited (Chrome autoplay), Blob URL memory leak on failed video, activeEffects Set mutation mid-iteration (blob-fx.js:94-104), split view 'both' mode never handled, _renderPass null entry crash, sublane listener leak, sublane waveform always blank, 60 lines dead code, iOS overlay file.type empty.

Decision: WebGL2 shader pipeline uses a separate hidden canvas, not p5's canvas. texImage2D uploads p5 canvas as texture, drawImage copies result back. Both GPU-accelerated. Keeps p5 rendering independent. CPU effects kept as fallbacks — GPU versions auto-skip CPU path via SHADER_EFFECT_REGISTRY. 8 blend modes via separate FRAG_BLEND shader with u_original + u_texture.

Decision: Lazy MediaPipe loading — models are 5-10MB, loading on page init adds seconds to startup. Load FaceLandmarker and InteractiveSegmenter on first mode activation. GPU delegate with CPU fallback. Use offscreen canvas for detectForVideo() — p5's video element is not a standard HTMLVideoElement in all contexts. FACE_DETECT_INTERVAL = 3 (run every 3rd frame, EMA smooth between).

Feedback: pixelDensity(1) must be called AFTER createCanvas, then resizeCanvas() must follow. In p5.js 1.9.0, pixelDensity(1) before createCanvas doesn't work — must call resizeCanvas() after to force buffer resize. Without this, Retina 2x = 5.5M pixels/frame, killing FPS to 3fps with 7 effects. 3.6x performance improvement.

Multi-agent harness pattern: GAN-inspired plan→build→evaluate pipeline using separate claude -p invocations for real context resets. Each agent gets own system prompt, tools, and JSON schema. Communication via sprint-contracts/ files. Evaluator tuned with 6 BlobFX-specific failure calibrations. Max 3 fix rounds per sprint. Design scoring: quality 30% + originality 30% + craft 20% + functionality 20%.

Feedback: Browser caches JS aggressively. Always use ?v=YYYYMMDD on script tags when changing JS files. Always remind to Cmd+Shift+R after changes. User couldn't see audio sync changes — browser cache was likely the #1 reason.

Decision: Purple-tinted design system (hsl 278°) for HUESOFSATURN brand. All grays carry purple hue. 3-layer CSS token system: primitives → semantic → component tokens. OKLCH gradient top bar (deep red → dark magenta → fuchsia → dark purple). Panels rgba(17,14,22,0.92). Accent #8B45E8.

Decision: Scratch buffer system — getScratchBuffer()/getScratchFloat() pool replaces ~20 per-frame new Uint8Array(pixels.length) allocations. Eliminates ~100MB/frame GC pressure with 3 stacked distortion effects. Reused across all pixel effects in blob-fx.js.

BlobFX rendering pipeline order: 0=Base Video, 1=Background Dim, 2=Effects (CPU + GPU + Datamosh), 3=Mask AI, 4=Overlay Video, 5=Blob Visualization (THERMO/ASCII source-direct), 6=UI Overlays. Datamosh uses persistent history FBO with frame-difference motion estimation (melt + shatter modes).

Decision: Timeline must NOT overlap side panels — positioned between them. Left/right = 358px (accounts for panel padding + box model). Segments use lerp interpolation with 0.3s default fade via segEnvelope() + lerpParam(). Discrete values (mode, hue) snap at envelope > 0.5. Capture-phase keydown listener for shortcuts fires before p5/browser.

Feedback: Deploy 4 parallel reviewer agents for full code audits on 5000+ line files. Split by domain: Effects agent, Tracking & MASK agent, Audio & Timeline agent, UI & State agent. Produces thorough, trustworthy results. Always verify execution paths before claiming features work — don't trust code reading alone, trace the full call chain.

Decision: FX_UI_CONFIG in blob-core.js is the single source of truth for all 63 effects. buildFxPanel() in blob-fx.js generates the entire FX panel from this config — replaced ~460 lines of static HTML. Click-to-apply UX: select=activate, eye=toggle visibility, trash=remove. FX browsing does NOT auto-enable effects.

Feedback: NEVER add flash/strobe effects without an explicit on/off toggle AND an epilepsy warning. Beat flash was removed from the Layers panel for this reason. Webcam mirror must only mirror the displayed video image via push/translate/scale/pop — effects, blobs, and coordinates must NOT be mirrored.
